message:
refactor(data): drop the invented rarity tiers

Rarity was never an in-game concept for stickers — it was a price band applied
by hand (Mythic simply meant top-3 by value), so labelling a 290-star cub skin
as MYTHIC was noise in a value list. Removed the field from bot/items.json and
src/data/items.ts, and every place that rendered it: item page subtitle,
specs table, JSON-LD, keywords and the unused translateRarity helper.
author: BSS Index Developer
